failure_record.log_evidence: cargo mutants found 44 mutants; three core invariant mutants timed out, each taking about five minutes despite a 20s test timeout; run ended after 13m with exit 3

diagnosis.cause: The pure tiber-core mutation recipe enabled --test-workspace true, so deliberately invalid core mutants ran higher-level CLI integration tests whose reconciliation loops spawn hanging subprocesses; package-only mutation testing completes promptly but revealed four missing direct getter assertions.

next_action.description: Restrict the pure-core mutation gate to tiber-core tests and add direct unit assertions for the four getter mutants previously caught only by workspace integration tests.
